title: RFID Paper Cards
description: RFID paper cards and tickets for transit, event and single-use identification workflows, with printable eco-friendly construction and chip options.
summary: RFID paper cards combine printable paper construction with embedded RFID technology for transit tickets, event passes and other temporary or eco-minded credential programs.

Widely used as single-journey tickets in metro systems, light railways, and at various events, these cards are also called RFID paper tickets. They offer a modern, environmentally friendly alternative for ticketing solutions.

faq.question: What are RFID Paper Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for transit tickets, event passes, temporary visitor credentials, and eco-friendly single- or short-use RFID card programs.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for RFID Paper Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: HF: Mifare 1k S50, 4K S70, ultralight, iCode, FM11RF08, etc. UHF: H9, UCODE 8/9, Monza M4QT, etc. Protocol: ISO14443/15693, ISO18000-6C Frequency: 13.56mhz, 860-960mhz, Read Range: 4-6cm (depending on reader)
